Subject: Converge Summit 2026 — exhibit technical rider & install window

- Preferred load-in day & time (primary window: Oct 11–12, 06:00–12:00)

Elliot

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Stone <elliot@converge-events.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge Summit 2026 — exhibit technical rider & install window

Hi Elliot — thanks for the rider and map. Looping in Kimberly (events ops) and Lauren (field marketing) to confirm logistics. A few items from our side for amendment before we commit:

1) Visibility & deliverables
- Can you confirm an upgrade for Redwood's logo placement in the mobile app (prominent banner day-of) and inclusion on the main stage loop between sessions? Those placements are important given our custom build.
- We need the pre-event sponsor spotlight in one pre-conference email (to 15k registrants) included in the package or as a credit.

2) Speaking slot
- The 30-min breakout is fine, but we would request a 45-min session or a dedicated 30+Q&A window (we have a live demo and would prefer 45 minutes). Please advise availability and whether that change affects cost.

3) Technical / install specs
- Our build is a modular 10'x20' island (custom backwall & overhead signage). We will need: two dedicated 20A circuits (separate breakers), one wired ethernet drop (Cat6), 2x 55" monitor outputs with HDMI and an AV feed to the breakout room for the demo capture.
- Confirm ceiling rigging availability for a 2.5m lightweight truss (attachments show standard pipe & drape only). If rigging is allowed, please itemize labor & rigging insurance.

4) Passes & staffing
- We require 5 full conference passes (3 included currently) and 2 additional expo-only badges. If there is an incremental fee, please include it in the amendment.

5) Costs & timing
- If custom rigging or upgraded app/mainstage exposure carries additional fees, please provide an itemized amendment and updated invoice. We will need the DocuSign link to approve.

If you can send an amended SOW showing the additional placements and rigging line items by next Monday (Sep 20), we can review and aim to sign by Sep 22.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Converge Summit — quick alignment before we push for changes

Kimberly / Lauren — quick internal notes from Elliot's rider. Want to align before we ask for anything aggressive.

- Visibility asks I'm putting on the table: mobile app banner, mainstage loop inclusion, and one dedicated pre-event email. If we get all three, negotiate a credit against the exhibitor fee (they usually charge for pre-event blasts).
- Speaking: I prefer the 45-min slot given our live demo (we'll need 20 extra minutes). If they only offer 30, push for an AV feed into the breakout room from the booth + a small Q&A mic setup.
- Tech: the modular 10'x20' will require 2x20A breakers and a Cat6 run; Lauren — what's our built booth power footprint and will our hardware need a UPS? Estimate budget for rigging labor if they won't comp it.
- Legal / insurance: Kimberly — can you confirm what their required limits are? Rider mentions general liability and additional insured naming; I want to pre-clear with finance/legal.

I'll tell Elliot we need an amended SOW and line-item pricing. If we can't get the app banner included, try to get a discounted pre-event email.

Marissa

From: Elliot Stone <elliot@converge-events.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sponsorships@converge-events.com
Date: 2026-09-20T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge Summit 2026 — exhibit technical rider & install window

Hi Marissa — appreciate the clear rundown. Good news: we can accommodate most of the asks. Summary of updates (see attached amendment):

- Visibility: upgraded mobile app banner (day-of prominent slot) and inclusion of Redwood logo in the main stage screen loop (medium size) are approved at no additional charge. We can also include one sponsor spotlight paragraph in the pre-conference email; we will reserve editorial control but will accept a 150-word blurb and image.

- Speaking: we have availability for a 45-minute breakout session in Track C on Oct 13 (2:15–3:00pm). That will be listed in the attendee schedule and promoted in session highlights.

- Technical / Rigging: ceiling rigging for a lightweight 2.5m truss is permitted in Hall B but requires advance approval and certified rigging crew. Itemized costs: rigging labor & supervision — $2,800; structural review & permit fee — $1,200. Dedicated electrical (2x 20A circuits) — $350; wired ethernet drop — $250. If you bring a third-party rigger, you must submit their certificate of insurance at least 21 days prior.

- Passes: we will provide 5 full conference passes and 2 expo-only passes (so no charge for extra passes in your case).

- Insurance: we require a general liability certificate naming Converge Events LLC as additional insured; limits as noted in page 4 of the rider.

Attachments: Converge_Sponsor_Amendment_v3.docx (DOCX), updated Converge_Exhibit_Rider_v3.pdf (PDF), HallB_Load_In_Map.png (PNG)

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/CONV-12345 (this link will open the amendment + invoice for signature)

Let me know if you want me to hold the 45-min slot while you review — I can tentatively reserve it for 72 hours.

Thanks,
Elliot
